perspective: I was talking with the recommender and asked for action movie suggestions. I mentioned that I like both hard-core and fun family action films, specifically *Abduction* (2011) and *Speed* (1994) with Keanu Reeves. The recommender asked whether I prefer hard-core or fun family action, and suggested *Mad Max* (1979). I said I liked that one but preferred *Mad Max: Fury Road* (2015) with Tom Hardy. The recommender then mentioned *Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi* (2017), but I said I never got into the Star Wars movies. The recommender brought up *Die Hard* (1988) as a popular Christmas movie, and I agreed it was pretty good with Bruce Willis. Finally, the recommender said they had just seen *Jumanji* (2017) that weekend.
